name: issue_to_pr_publication_result
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

push.description: git_push output: pushed and publicationState. Non-object treated as empty.

pr.description: pr_create (or similar) output: publicationState, number, url. Non-object treated as empty; takes precedence over push when both set publicationState.

publicationState.description: pr.publicationState if a string, else push.publicationState if a string, else "publication_unavailable".

pushed.description: True only if push.pushed is exactly true.

url.description: pr.url when a string, else empty string.
